title: RoofFlatFromWalls Command
description: Create a flat roof slab from the outermost closed outline on the wall source layer (same footprint path as floor_from_layer). Requires Forsk walls. Slab top at wall bbox Max.Z (or elevation); thickness extrudes downward. Default thickness 200, overhang 0.

layer.description: Fallback source layer for the outline when walls lack forsk:source_layer. Default wall. Usually taken from the first wall's forsk:source_layer.

thickness.description: Slab thickness in document units (mm). Default 200. Extrudes downward from the slab top.

overhang.description: Constant WorldXY offset of the outline in document units. Default 0. Largest-area closed offset wins; unoffset footprint kept if offset fails.

elevation.description: Optional absolute Z for the slab top. Default is max wall bbox Max.Z.

target_layer.description: Layer for new roof slabs. Created if missing. Default A-ROOF.

name_prefix.description: Name prefix for new slabs (roof-01, roof-02, …).

join_tolerance.description: Join tolerance for open segments. Default is max(10× model tolerance, 1).
